snippet.title: Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Get another look at Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard in this trailer for the upcoming action-adventure game that follows the extraordinary journey of three unlikely heroes. The new Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard trailer dives into details of a real-life treasure hunt, along with unveiling a release date. Chickenhare, Meg and Abe will have to make good use of their unique talents to progress through the game, solving puzzles, platform-hopping with accuracy and kicking enemies around. Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, and Xbox Series X/S on October 14, 2025.
